attempts.summary: Every write of a card's profile label now goes through setAgent (src/tasks.js): it adds the label it is given and removes every other kb:agent:*, so `hkb adopt <n> --agent X` and `hkb claim <n> --profile X` are a set, not an add. Adopting a decomposed root as claude-track now actually makes it a track — verified end to end in test/agent-label.test.js by replaying the worked example from references

residual_risk: agentOf stays first-wins: a card with two kb:agent:* labels still dispatches silently as the first one until someone runs hkb doctor or re-adopts it. Deliberate — see the summary.
The dispatcher does not normalise a doubled label when it claims a card (src/dispatch.js is outside this task's paths); adopt and doctor are the repair path.
hkb doctor now costs one extra GraphQL board query per run (no extra REST calls).
hkb adopt still does not validate --agent against board.json profiles, so a typo'd profile is a card that never dispatches. Out of scope here; worth its own card.
verification: node --test test/agent-label.test.js against the pre-fix adopt/claim code: the 3 adopt cases and the claim case fail, confirming they are not vacuous

results.summary:
Every write of a card's profile label now goes through setAgent (src/tasks.js): it adds the label it is given and removes every other kb:agent:*, so `hkb adopt <n> --agent X` and `hkb claim <n> --profile X` are a set, not an add. Adopting a decomposed root as claude-track now actually makes it a track — verified end to end in test/agent-label.test.js by replaying the worked example from references/protocol.md and asserting the dry-run tick reports "would run track #41 → #42 → #12 as one claude-track session".

hkb doctor grew checkAgentLabels: it names every open card wearing two kb:agent:* labels, both profiles, which one it actually runs as (first-wins), and the `hkb adopt <n>... --agent <profile>` that repairs it. It is a warning, not a failure — the board still dispatches, just as the wrong profile. It reads labels only, so fetchBoard learned `{ blockers: false }` to skip the per-task REST blocker fill-in on repos without the GraphQL blockedBy field.

On point 3 of the issue (make the resolver fail loudly): deliberately not done. agentOf stays first-wins because throwing there would break `hkb show`, `hkb list` and the tick on exactly the boards that need diagnosing; the new pure agentsOf (src/model.js) carries the ambiguity to doctor instead, where a human is reading. That decision is recorded in the code comments and the PR body.

No protocol/SKILL.md change was needed — the documented line now works as written. docs/wiki/GLOSSARY.md's *Profile* entry carries the new invariant.

Draft PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/127 (branch worktree-kb-113-1, rebased on origin/main at 68765e6).
